Class NeuralNetworkAnalysisCase

java.lang.Object
sysmlinjava.common.SysMLAnything
sysmlinjava.occurrences.SysMLOccurrence
sysmlinjava.actions.SysMLAction
sysmlinjava.actions.SysMLCalculation
sysmlinjava.actions.SysMLCase
sysmlinjava.analysis.SysMLAnalysisCase
sysmlinjava.analysis.ParametricAnalysisCase
sysmlinjava.views.neuralnetdisplay.NeuralNetworkAnalysisCase
All Implemented Interfaces:
AttributeObserver, ObservableAttribute, StateBehaviorContext
public abstract class NeuralNetworkAnalysisCase extends ParametricAnalysisCase
Abstract parametric analysis case for the parametric analysis of a neural network. Analysis parameters are the values that are input to the neural network's input neuraons and output from its output neurons. Both inputs and outputs are sent to a neural network display application for display in a inputs/outputs table that can be used to analyze the performance of the neural net.

    • NeuralNetworkAnalysisCase

      public NeuralNetworkAnalysisCase(Optional<ParametricAnalysisCase> parent, boolean logToConsole)
      Constructor
      Parameters:
      parent - the ParametricAnalysisCase in whose context the neural net's input and output constraint parameters are located.
      logToConsole - whether to send all transmit() logs to console. Note: transmit() operation can log every object's toString() string to the console. The more frequently log messages are sent to console, the greater the CPU resources are needed. This can cause noticable slowing of the console display and related applications.

    • start

      public void start()
      Description copied from class: ParametricAnalysisCase
      Starts the parametric analysis case's state machine behavior, if a state machine is present. The operation submits an InitialEvent to the state machine's event queue to thereby start its execution thread. The state machine will execute in accordance with the states and transitions that are defined in the stateMachine.
      Specified by:
      start in interface StateBehaviorContext
      Overrides:
      start in class ParametricAnalysisCase

      • SysMLPart.start()

    • stop

      public void stop()
      Description copied from class: ParametricAnalysisCase
      Stops the part's state machine-based behavior, if a state machine is present in the part. The operation simply stops the state machine execution. Note if this part's state machine is asynchronous, i.e. executes in its own thread, then this operation imposes a "hard stop" where the thread is canceled regardless of what state it's in. If the part's state machine is synchronous, this operation can only queue up a FinalEvent to the event queue, on the assumption that the state machine is capable of handling the FinalEvent at the point in which the stop() method is invoked. Therefore, if a part is synchronous and this stop method is used, it's state machine should be modeled to handle the FinalEvent accordingly.
      Specified by:
      stop in interface StateBehaviorContext
      Overrides:
      stop in class ParametricAnalysisCase

    • perform

      public void perform()
      Operation that performs the constraint specified by the constraint variable. After performing the constraint, the operation notifies the output parameter port of the value change so it can update the value in its bound parameter. It then proceeds to transmit the neural net's input and output data sets to the neural net display, if the display is configured for this constraint block.

      This operation performs the complete activity needed for most applications of the neural net constraint block and need not be overridden unless a different/custom activity is needed.

      Overrides:
      perform in class SysMLAnalysisCase

    • createParameters

      protected void createParameters()
      Description copied from class: ParametricAnalysisCase
      Overridable abstract operation that should create the analysis's parameters initializing them and the "put"-ing the initialized instances of each into the params map with their appropriate "key"s, i.e. their parameter IDs. An example follows: 
      
 		:
	&#64;Override
	protected void createParameters()
	{
		params = KeyValueMap.of(
			List.of("paramA", "paramB", "paramC"),
			List.of(new FirstParamType(), new NextParamType(), new LastParamType()));
	}
      Note each parameter must be a type of SysMLAttributeType as the SysMLAttributeType provides the features needed for binding of analysis parameters to attributes.
      Overrides:
      createParameters in class ParametricAnalysisCase
      See Also:
      • SysMLAttributeType
